ambiguities_declared: The section references the substantive criteria of § 141.603, § 141.604, § 141.623(a), and § 141.620(c) without restating them; those requirements are not classifiable from this section's text alone.

challenge_questions.expected_answer: The system must qualify for a 40/30 certification under § 141.603 or have received a very small system waiver under § 141.604, must meet the reduced monitoring criteria in § 141.623(a), and must not change or add monitoring locations from those used for compliance monitoring under subpart L.
challenge_questions.question: What three conditions must a system meet to remain on reduced TTHM/HAA5 monitoring after the dates identified in § 141.620(c)?

challenge_questions.expected_answer: The system may not remain on reduced monitoring after the dates identified in § 141.620(c) for compliance with this subpart.
challenge_questions.question: What happens if a system's monitoring locations under this subpart differ from its monitoring locations under subpart L?

verified_quotes.exact_text: You may remain on reduced monitoring after the dates identified in § 141.620(c) for compliance with this subpart only if you qualify for a 40/30 certification under § 141.603 or have received a very small system waiver under § 141.604, plus you meet the reduced monitoring criteria in § 141.623(a), and you do not change or add monitoring locations from those used for compliance monitoring under subpart L of this part.

If your monitoring locations under this subpart differ from your monitoring locations under subpart L of this part, you may not remain on reduced monitoring after the dates identified in § 141.620(c) for compliance with this subpart.
